entities.summary: Jim Pugh is a former professional tennis player from the United States. He grew up in Palos Verdes, California and at age 10 began taking tennis lessons from John Hillebrand. He played tennis at UCLA. He became a doubles specialist on the ATP Tour and won three Grand Slam men's doubles titles and five Grand Slam mixed doubles titles. Pugh reached the world No. 1 doubles ranking in 1989.
